faqs.question: Is the first consultation free or paid?
faqs.answer: Sample answer: consultation fee and duration will be confirmed before the appointment.

faqs.question: Can I consult remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. Phone, WhatsApp, and email consultations are available for document review and initial legal direction.

faqs.question: Will my matter stay confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. Shared facts, documents, and strategy are handled as confidential legal information.

faqs.question: What happens after I contact SAB?
faqs.answer: You receive a document checklist, consultation time, risk review, and clear next-step recommendation.
